 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VIKAS MAHAJAN  ORDER % 08.09.2025 1.

The present petition has been filed seeking following relief:
"a.

Issue appropriate writ, order or direction thereby setting aside/quash the Impugned Speaking Order bearing SZ (294) 2024/DD/LM/SZ/DDA/957 dated 26.08.2025 passed by the Deputy Director (LM), South Zone-II, Delhi Development Authority, with respect to the land admeasuring 12 Biswa and 10 Biswaniss comprised in Khasra No. 120 situated in the revenue estate of the Village Satbari, Delhi;
AND b. Issue appropriate writ, order or direction to the Respondents for passing a well-reasoned speaking order after due consideration of the true and correct factual
This is a digitally signed order.

2.

Mr. Bharat Arora, learned counsel appearing on behalf of petitioner submits that the present petition is limited to an issue that the impugned order dated 26.08.2025 which has been styled as a speaking order, in fact, is not a speaking order which has been passed pursuant to the direction given by this Court in its order dated Indimo Telecommunication Llp vs Govt Of Nct Of Delhi And Ors on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181856489/

sentences.text: He further submits that pursuant to the direction given by this Court vide order dated 10.07.2025, a show cause notice came to be issued to the petitioner on the same date i.e. on 10.07.2025.

4. A reply dated 22.07.2025 was given by the petitioner to the said show cause notice inter alia contending that the land has been purchased by the petitioner for consideration and the agreement to sell whereby the said land was purchased clearly states that no compensation has been paid to the previous owners.
5.

He submits that the impugned order dated 26.08.2025 only reproduces the contents of the show cause notice, and that apart, only observation made is that the compensation for the acquired land stands deposited with the Land Acquisition Collector, but no details have been given in the said order as to how, when and to whom the said compensation was paid.
6. In view of the above, issue notice.
Ms. Malvika Kapila Kalra, learned counsel appearing on behalf of respondent no.3/DDA accepts notice.
7. Mr. Sanjay Kumar Pathak, learned Standing Counsel appearing on This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 10/09/2025 at 22:00:49 behalf of respondent no.1/GNCTD and respondent no.2/LAC accepts notice.

8. Ms. Kapila submits that Notification in terms of Section 4 of Land Acquisition Act,
1894 was issued in the year 1980 and the present sale transaction on which the reliance is being placed by the petitioner is of 22.06.2021.
She submits that any transfer which takes place post issuance of Section 4 notification is void ab initio.
9. She submits that the impugned order clearly records that the compensation of the acquired land has already been paid.
10. She further contends that the predecessor-in-interest of the petitioner had also filed writ petitions seeking declaration to the effect that acquisition proceedings have lapsed.
However, the said writ petitions have also been dismissed.

11. Let counter affidavit be filed within a period of two weeks.
12. Rejoinder thereto be filed before the next date.
